items.question: What locus and dissolution of inner radiance secure freedom from aging and death?
premises: A radiance is situated in the throat-cavity.
Attaining this absorption completes the state of freedom from decay and disease described previously.
items.inference: By reaching absorption in the brahma-aperture through the radiance situated in the throat-cavity, one abides in the liberated condition.
uncertainties: The feminine subject of gatā is implicit and may refer to awareness, energy, or the practitioner.
The syntactic relation to the preceding verses is inferred from context rather than explicit markers.
items.plain_english: Having gone to absorption in the brahma-aperture, through the radiance situated in the throat-cavity.
